pomer.heading: Pomer, house 5: where the Kirac mother came from — three books walked end to end, a household followed for ninety years, and a surname corrected
pomer.lead: **The Medulin books named Maria Defranceschi «oriunda e Pomer» and gave her father and mother. They did not say where Pomer's own books put them. They do, and it is the first time this archive has had a Defranceschi household from its marriage to its end.** *Tomas Defranceschi, a farmer of Pomer and son of the late Michele, married Maddalena Buich on 16 August 1843. Their daughter Lucia was born in 1844, a son Michele in 1847 and Maria in 1852. **Tomas died of typhus on 5 April 1858, Michele at fourteen in December 1861.** Maria went to Medulin, where eight children followed her; Lucia stayed, married a Lazaro, bore nine children and buried six of them before they were nine. Their mother Magdalena, a widow from 1858, delivered the village's babies as its midwife, and her son by an unnamed father grew up to be Stephanus Buić and had eight children of his own.* ***And the Pomer registers make one correction to this archive's own record: the mother was never «Magdalena Davić». She is Buich — Buić — in four entries, two hands and three kinds of book.***

rows.lab: 1816 · Magdalena herself is baptised
rows.text:
**Born 11 July 1816, baptised 14 July, house «Nº 28»** — *read at 1.6× beside the same scribe's «16», «17» and «33» on the page: the second digit is closed at both ends, an 8; at lower magnification it had looked like a 6, and an earlier draft of this row said 26.* «***Madalena Buich***» to «***Paolo Buich, campagnuolo***» *(a countryman — an occupation, not a surname)* and «***Cattarina, campagnuola***» *(her own surname is not written)*; baptised by *Matteo Quasich*. The godparents' names were not read with confidence. **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [627](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99F-KXTM?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 6, register page 3, left; waypoint 9R2F-FMH; the number burned into the image reads 626 — it runs one behind the frame number FamilySearch gives the image).* ***This is the entry the 1843 marriage («Maddalena Buich gm Paolo», aged 27, house 28) pointed at, and it agrees three ways: 1843 − 27 = 1816, the father is Paolo, and the house is 28.***

**⭐ And her brother is three pages on.** *Page 10, a page the clerk later reused, carries* «***Buich Francesco***», *Catholic, male, legitimate, house **28**, to* «***Buich Paolo, agricoltore***» *and* «***Cattarina nata Premuy***» *(the surname magnified and read with less confidence), baptised by D. Antonio Vatta in **August 1819** (page header «1819»; a July date is struck through).* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [630](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L99F-KXRL?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH), right page (births frame 9).* ***So Paolo Buich and Cattarina are at house 28 in 1816 and 1819, and Magdalena is at house 28 when she marries in 1843 — twenty-seven years in one house.***

*Found while reading the front of the book for Defranceschi, and **not** by looking for her — it is a Buich, and a surname search for the name would have walked past it.* ⚠ **The identification rests on first name, surname, father's first name, year and house; the entry does not say she married Tomas. A second Magdalena Buich in the same year at the same house is not credible, but the link is an inference, not a statement.**

rows.lab: 1827 · a Defranceschi named in a margin — Gregorio, before Tomas
rows.text: **22 July 1827, Pomer, the last baptism on register page 5** — a child *Madalena*, house 22, to a *Martin* and *Agata nata Sicco*. **Under the ruled page, in a different ink, someone has added who the godmother was:** «***Antº Vejali e sua […]ganita figlia di Greg.º Defranceschi***». **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [628](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99F-KXP7?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 7, left page; burned-in number 627), the surname magnified at 1.6×.* ***That is a man of the name at Pomer a generation before Tomas — with a daughter already married by 1827, so himself born by about 1780.*** *He is a godmother's father and nothing more: no baptism, marriage or death of his own has been found, and the forename is the abbreviated «Greg.º», read with less confidence than the surname.* ⚠ **No join is claimed to Tomas (son of Michele, b. c. 1800), or to the Gregorio Defranceschi who witnessed a wedding at Svetvinčenat in 1780.** *A Gregorio, a daughter and a Vejali husband are three things to look for in the Pomer marriages and deaths; the book has not been read far enough to say.*

rows.lab: 1843 · the marriage
rows.text: **16 August 1843, Pomer, house 5.** «*Tommaso Defranceschi, rustico, gm Michele*» — **aged 43, celibe** — and «*Maddalena Buich, gm Paolo, rustica*», **house 28, aged 27, celibe**. Witnesses *Matteo Zuccon* (*agente comunale*) and *Antonio Giacopilla* (*nonzolo di Pomer*). The document column: «*Permesso politico per ambi due essendo maggiorenni e Certificato della Dottrina Cristiana*». **`doc`** — *DGS 005497827, frame [10](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L99F-V9F5?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-ZNT) (waypoint 9R2F-ZNT).* ***Born about 1800 and about 1816: an inference from the stated ages, not a record of birth.***

rows.lab: 1844 · Lucia
rows.text: **Born 27 September 1844, baptised the 29th, house 5.** «*Lucia Defranceschi, natali 27 corrente*», *Femmina, Legittima*, to «***Tommaso Defranceschi gm Michele, agricoltore***» and «***Maddalena Buich gm Paolo***»; godparents *Nicolò Bosaz* and *Anna sua moglie*. **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [633](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-KXHQ?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (waypoint 9R2F-FMH).* **Both grandfathers are named, and both are already dead: Michele Defranceschi and Paolo Buich.**

rows.lab: 1847 · Michele
rows.text: **Born 4 October 1847, baptised the 5th, house 5.** «*Michiele nato li 4 Ottobre 1847*» to «*Tomaso De-franceschi Agri.*» and «*Mandallena nata Buich Agri.*»; godparents *Antonio Vicario q. Domin.* and his wife Margherita. **Named for his father's father.** **`doc`** — *frame 635.* *Nothing is known of him after the entry.*

rows.lab: 1852 · Maria
rows.text: **Born 1 June 1852, baptised the 6th, house 5.** «*Maria nata 1 hujus*» to «***Thoma Defranceschi, Def. Michaelis filius***» and «***Magdalena nata Buich***»; godparents *Blasius Mihovilović q. Thoma* and *Maria vidua Tonetti*. **`doc`** — *frame 637.* **She is the Maria who married Petrus Kirac at Medulin in 1874 and had eight children; until now this archive had «born about 1852», inferred from «aged 22».** *The hyphen splits the surname across the line — «Defran- / ceschi» — exactly as the Medulin scribe split it in 1874.*

rows.lab: 1866 · Lucia marries a Lazaro
rows.text: **«*Lucia Defranceschi f. Thomae et Magdalenae Buić*», aged 21, marries «*Matheus Lazzaro q. Mathei*», aged 29, on 23 January 1866.** **`doc`** — *DGS 005497827, frame [15](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99F-V9JD?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-ZNT).* *The entry is written into a gap between July 1864 and June 1865 and so sits out of order on the page; **the year reads 1866 and both ages agree with it** — she was 21 from September 1865, he 29 from October 1865 — so the order is the scribe's slip, not the date's.* *His mother's name is written across a hard line and was not read with confidence.*

rows.lab: 1866 · Euphemia — the first child, born ten months after the wedding
rows.text: **Born 31 October 1866, baptised 4 November, house 33: «*Eufemia*»** — *the first entry on the first written page of the 1866–1900 book.* Father «***Matthaeus Lazaro, Miles et Possid[ens]***» (*a soldier and a landholder*), mother «***Lucia n. Defranceschi, Agricola***» — *her surname written «Defranceski», with the -ski that the clerks of this later book use.* Godparents *Giacobus Scattaro* and *Euphemia Sikić*; the clerk's midwife column reads «*Maria Buić, non approbata*» (*an unlicensed midwife — a Buić, as it happens, and nothing is claimed from that*). **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [655](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99F-KXFJ?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 34, right-hand page 1; waypoint 9R2F-FMH), the line magnified at 1.15×.* ***Three things it settles.*** **1.** *The married couple are at **house 33** — the house where Lucia's father Tomas died and where her mother was a widow in 1859 — so the Lazaro household began inside the Defranceschi one; by 1870 it is at house 60.* **2.** *Matheus Lazaro is a **serving or discharged soldier** with land, not only a «farmer».* **3.** *The FamilySearch index, which gave six Lazaro baptisms between 1870 and 1884, did not contain this one: **the first child was born in 1866 and the index starts four years later.*** ⚠ *A struck-through marginal date ending «/70» stands beside the entry and could not be read with confidence; **it is not read as a death**, and the deaths books were walked for 1867–1910 for Defranceschi, not for Lazaro: whether Euphemia lived is not established.*

rows.lab: 1868 · Maria, and the midwife is her grandmother
rows.text:
**Born 6 December 1868, baptised the 10th, house 33: «*Maria*»**, to «***Mattey Lazaro, agricola***» and «***Lucia Defranceschi, Agricola***» (*written «De-franc-/eschi» across the cell*); godparents *Antonio Volchić «dai Sikić»* and *Maria Kuhtić*. **And in the last column, the midwife — «*Magdalena V.va De-fran-/ceschi*»: Magdalena, widow Defranceschi.** **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [656](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99F-KXNS?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 35, right-hand page 3; waypoint 9R2F-FMH), magnified at 1.15×; the midwife's name is broken across three lines by the cell's width and every syllable is legible.* ***That is Magdalena Buić, nine years a widow, delivering her own daughter's second child in the house where she lived.*** *The midwife column is otherwise filled by «Maria V.va Buić», «Maria Gersić», «Maria Fabaz», «Justina V.va Vajak» — the women of Pomer who delivered its children — and is **ruled «non approbata»** for most of them. Magdalena is the only Defranceschi among them.* **`inf`** *— it is her, and not another widow of the name, because Tomas's widow is the only «Magdalena V.va Defranceschi» this archive knows at Pomer and she is named as that in the 1859 baptism two pages back in the old book; a second one is possible and not excluded.* ***She is alive on 6 December 1868 — and, with the 1874 Medulin marriage, again in 1874 — so her death falls after December 1868 and may be after 1874.*** *This also dates a trade: a Defranceschi woman, widowed with children, earning as a village midwife.*

**⭐ And she is still delivering children eleven years later.** *On* ***25 January 1880*** *— baptism 11 of the year, the child «Antonius», born the 23rd to* *Lucas Zucon, widower's son, and Maria Radešović* — *the midwife column reads* «***Magdalena De-/franceschi***» *across two lines.* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [667](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-KXC6?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 46, page 20 at the seam with page 21), magnified at 1.15×; the entry is on the left-hand image and its last column runs onto the edge of the right-hand one, so the word is read across the join.* ***Magdalena is alive on 25 January 1880 — twelve years after the 1868 entry and six years after the Medulin marriage of 1874 — and by then about 64.*** *The «V.va» of 1868 is not legible on this line, so the identification is again* **`inf`**: *the same name, in the same column, in the same parish, fourteen years on, and she is the only woman of the name we can place there.* **Her death is therefore after 25 January 1880** — *a bound that narrows the deaths-book search to 1880–1910.*

rows.lab: 1870–75 · the Lazaro household, and two small graves
rows.text:
**House 60.** *Matheus Lazaro and Lucia Defranceschi had nine children between 1866 and 1884 — the FamilySearch index gave six from 1870, and the 1866 and 1868 daughters above precede it — and buried two of the three born from 1870. Antonius Matheus's own baptism was read on 14 August 1870 (born the 6th, house 60, «Lucia Defrance-/schi Agricola», midwife Maria Fabac; DGS 005497826, frame [657](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-KXFJ?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH)): the family had moved from house 33 to house 60 between December 1868 and August 1870.* **Antonius Matheus** *(born 6 August 1870) was buried on* **1 March 1873**, *aged 2 years 6 months 24 days — «filius legit. Mathei Lazaro, et Luciae Defranceschi, agricolae»: the entry names her mother's family outright, and the age lands on the birth date to the day.* **Matheus** *(baptised 5 January 1873, born the 2nd) was buried on* **12 September 1875**, *aged 2.* **`doc`** — *births frame 661; deaths frame 30 (DGS 005497827_00074).* **The father outlived them by a quarter-century: «*Matthaeus Lazar qd. Matthaei, maritus Luciae Defranceschi*» was buried on 27 September 1899, aged 62 years 11 months 20 days, of consumption — so Lucia was alive that day, and he was born about October 1836.**

**⭐ And a third grave, read from a margin.** *Jacobus — born **24 June 1875**, baptised 30 July, house 60, «Matthaeus Lazar» and «Lucia n. Defranceschi» — has a cross and «**22/11 1883**» written beside his baptism: he died on 22 November 1883, aged eight.* **`doc`** *— DGS 005497826, frame [663](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99F-KXVZ?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 42, page 14), magnified at 1.15×.* *The index gave his baptism as «24 Jul 1875»: that is the **baptism** month; he was born in June.* **So of the children known, Antonius Matheus (1873), Matheus (1875) and Jacobus (1883) are dead before their father, and the 1866 and 1868 daughters are unaccounted for.** ⚠ *The 1883 death was read from the margin and not yet checked against the deaths book, which was walked for Defranceschi and not for Lazaro.*

**⭐ A fourth, and she is in no index.** ***Euphemia* — born 15 March 1878, baptised the 19th, house 60, «Matthaeus Lazar, Rusticus» and «Lucia Defranceschi»** (*godparents Antonius Zocon and Maria Mihovilović; midwife Maria Fabac*) — **has a cross and «8/11 79» beside her entry: she died on 8 November 1879, aged one year and eight months.** **`doc`** *— DGS 005497826, frame [665](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99F-KXK5?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 44, page 18), magnified at 1.15×.* *The FamilySearch index, which gave six baptisms for this couple, **does not contain her**: the household is now **nine** children on record (1866, 1868, 1870, 1873, 1875, 1878, 1880, 1882, 1884 — the 1882 and 1884 entries still to be read), with **four of them known from margins to have died young.**

***Zorica* — born 14 March 1880, baptised the 15th, house 60** — «*Zorica (sl. Albina)*», *the clerk giving both the Croatian and the Latin-script form,* to «*Matthaeus Lazar, Agricola*» and «*Lucia nata Defranceschi, Rustica*»; godparents *Antonius Tukopila* and *Matthia, wife of Paulus Uguerin*; midwife «*Maria, wife of Martinus Lazar*» *(a relation of the father, by the name).* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [667](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-KXC6?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 46, page 21), magnified at 1.15×.* ***This is the index's «Zorica Or Albina», 14 Mar 1880, explained: the register itself wrote the two names, one in brackets.*** *It is the seventh child on record.*

***Josephus* — born 24 August 1882, house 46** (*the family has moved again, from 60 to 46*) — «*Matthaeus Lazaro qm Matthaei, agricola*» and «*Lucia n. Defranceschi*»; godmother *Maria, daughter of Nicolaus Vojak*; **and the midwife is «*Magdalena Va Defranceschi*»** — *Magda-/lena Va / De-franceschi* *across three lines.* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [670](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-KXQ8?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 49, page 25), read in two crops at 1.15×.* ***That is Magdalena's third appearance as midwife: 1868, 1880, 1882. «Va», the widow's mark, is legible this time, so she is Tomas's widow and no other**, and she is alive on 24 August 1882 at about 66.

***Catharina* — born 29 November 1884, baptised the 30th, house 46** — «*Lazar Matthaeus qm Matthaei, agricola*» and «***Defranceschi Lucia q.m Thoma***»: **the mother is written as the daughter of the late Thomas — in her own children's baptism, 41 years after her parents' wedding, the clerk still names her father.** **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [671](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-KX87?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 50, page 27), magnified at 1.15×.* ***And in the margin, in a 1954 hand: «Umro u Puli dana 3.VII 1954» — died at Pula on 3 July 1954, aged 69,** with the register's death number «357/54» and the registrar's signature of 17 August 1954.* *The marginal note is a **modern civil-registry annotation** on a church baptism; it is `doc` for the note, and no other record of her death was seen.* ***She is the only one of the nine known to have lived to old age.*** *This is the 1884 baptism the FamilySearch index listed as «29 Nov 1884»: the index gave the birth date, correctly.*

***Maria, the 1868 daughter, may be the «Maria Lazar filia Mathei et Luciae» who is a mother in 1889.*** *24 November 1889, «Pomer, Lampana 115»: «Nicolaus», born the 21st, to «Joannes [surname read «Frost», uncertain] filius Thomae, agricola» and «**Maria Lazar filia Mathei et Luciae**»; godparents Joannes Mirkovic and Maria his wife; midwife «Maria Lazar, non examinata».* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [681](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-KX4Y?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 61/62 seam, page 36, entry 21), magnified at 1.15×; a registrar's stamp beside it records Nicolaus's own death at Pomer on 1 August 1968.* **`inf`** *— the parents' forenames match Matheus and Lucia, and the age (21 in 1889) fits Maria b. 1868, but «Lazar» is a common name at Pomer, «Lucia» has no surname in this entry, and there is no house number tying her to house 60 or 46. **Not merged and not claimed.***

***⭐ And the widow herself, working, eleven weeks after the burial.*** *17 December 1899, Pomer: a «Maria», born the 7th, to «**Joannes Trost** gd. Antonii agricola» and «**Maria Lazar** def. Matthaei»; godparents Michael Perissa and Agatha Kirac; **the midwife is «*Lucia Vid. Lazar*»** — Lucia, widow of a Lazar.* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [699](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-K6B1?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 79, page 58, entry 22); the midwife's first two words magnified at 1.15× and the rest of the line read at 1800px; the register's own printed note «def. Matthaei» (daughter of the late Matthew) sits under the mother's name.* ***Three facts fit together: (1) «Matthaeus Lazar qd. Matthaei» was buried on 27 September 1899 — eleven weeks earlier; (2) the mother is «Maria Lazar, daughter of the late Matthaeus»; (3) the midwife is a «Vid. Lazar» named Lucia.*** `inf` — **Lucia Defranceschi, a widow from 27 September 1899 and still a village midwife, delivering the child of her own daughter Maria (b. 1868) and Joannes Trost** *— the same pattern as her own mother Magdalena, who delivered Lucia's children in 1868, 1880 and 1882. This is a second reading of «Maria Lazar filia Mathei et Luciae» in the 1889 baptism, now with a husband (Joannes Trost, labourer's son), and the earlier doubt is largely removed: the father is dead in 1899 and the midwife is his widow.* ⚠ *Still an inference: «Lucia» and «Lazar» are both common names at Pomer, and nobody writes «Defranceschi» on this page. Not merged with the roster row for Maria Lazaro b. 1868 until the Pomer marriage book is read for Trost.*

***⭐⭐ Lucia is alive on 2 July 1905, and the youngest child marries.*** **2 July 1905, Pomer: «*Joannes Zuccon, agricola*», aged 25, born 8 April 1880, and «*Catharina Lazar, agricola*», aged 20, born 29 November 1884.** *The groom's parents: «Antonius Zuccon, pistor [baker], catholicus» and «† Euphemia Kirac». **The bride's: «† Mathaei Lazar, agricola, catholicus» and «Lucia De-france-/schi, catholica».** Witnesses *Antonius Hrvatin, aeditus (sexton)* and *Petrus Mihovilović, operarius*; the priest *Joannes Barbalić*.* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497827 (marriages 1885–1910), frame [37](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-V952?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-ZNT), page 26 (left) and 36 (right), the parents' cells magnified at 1.15×.* ***Three things at once.*** **1. A cross stands before «Mathaei Lazar» and before «Euphemia Kirac» — the register's mark for a dead parent — and none before «Lucia Defranceschi»: she is alive in July 1905, six years a widow, aged about 61.** **2. The bride is Catharina Lazaro, b. 29 Nov 1884 — the child whose 1954 death at Pula is in the baptism margin — so the youngest of the nine has now been followed to a wedding and a grave, and her husband is a Pomer Zuccon.** **3. The surname is spelled out in full and exactly as in the 1843 marriage — «Defranceschi» — sixty-two years later, in a mother's cell.** *This is the last Defranceschi entry in the marriages book to 1910 that has been found: **Lucia herself was born in 1844 and her death is not in the births book's reach; the deaths book 1867–1910 was read for Defranceschi, and was not read for «Lazar vidua» or «Lucia Lazar», and that is the next thing to do.***

***⭐ The deaths book confirms Jacobus, and adds a fifth grave.*** **22 November 1883, house 46: «*Lazaro Jacobus filius Matthai agricolae*», male, aged 8 years 6 months 23 days, angina** — *exactly the date written in the margin of his baptism, and the age lands on 24 June 1875 to the day.* **28 January 1884, house 46: «*Lazaro Josephus filius Matthai agricolae*», aged 1 year 5 months 4 days, angina** — ***that is the Josephus born 24 August 1882, whose baptism carried no margin note; the register of burials supplies his death.*** **`doc`** — *DGS 005497827 (deaths 1842–1910, waypoint 9R2F-6YM), frame [78](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L99F-V9ZG?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-6YM) (deaths frame 34, left page 16, entries 9 of 1883 and 3 of 1884).* **Both within five weeks, of the same throat illness, from house 46.** ***Two more deaths read in the same book:*** **8 November 1879, house 60: «*Euphemia filia Matthai Lazar agr.*», aged 1½, fever** *(frame 76, deaths frame 32, page 13, entry 12 — the Euphemia born 15 March 1878)* — **and 17 March 1880, house 60: «*Zorica (Albina) Lazar filia Matthaei*», aged 4 days, fever** *(frame 77, deaths frame 33, left page 14, entry 3 — three days after her baptism, under the same double name the baptism wrote).* **`doc`.** ***So the nine children: Euphemia (1866, ?), Maria (1868, married Joannes Trost), Antonius Matheus (1870–73), Matheus (1873–75), Jacobus (1875–83), Euphemia (1878–79), Zorica/Albina (1880, four days), Josephus (1882–84), Catharina (1884–1954) — six dead before they were nine, five of them in house 60 or 46 before their father, and two daughters followed to adulthood.*** *The first Euphemia of 1866 is not in the books read; whether she lived is not known.*

***Matheus's burial and the Trost children.*** *The burial entry of 27 September 1899 reads in full:* «***Matthaeus Lazor** (*sic*) *qd. Matthaei, maritus Luciae Defranceschi, agricola*», **house 46**, *62 years 11 months 20 days, consumption, buried the 29th* **`doc`** *— DGS 005497827, frame [86](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99F-V9ZJ?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-6YM) (deaths frame 43, left page 34, entry 8 of 1899); the clerk spells «Lazor» in the name cell and «Defranceschi» in full beside it, and calls her his wife.* ***And the Maria Trost born to Maria Lazar's household in December 1899 died on 27 October 1900, aged 10 months, of weakness («debolezza»), and her brother Natalis Trost, 2 years 10 months, the day before.*** *Joannes Trost's two children were buried on 27 and 29 October 1900 (frame 88, deaths frame 44, page 36, entries 14–15).* **`doc`** *The «Maria Lazar def. Matthaei» of the 1899 baptism is the mother of both.*

rows.lab: 1885–90 · A second Defranceschi household at Pomer — a labourer from Ližnjan, followed to Pula
rows.text:
**24 February 1886, Pomer, house 17: baptism of «*Mathias*», born the 21st** — father «***Defranceschi Antonius filius Antonii, e Liciniana, operarius***» (*son of Antonius, from Lisignano, a labourer*), mother «***Radešić Euphemia qm Antonii, e Porgnana parochia Barbanae***» (*daughter of the late Antonius, of Porgnana in the parish of Barban*); godmother *Maria Buić, daughter of Carolus*; midwife *Agatha Rakić*. **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [676](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99F-KXDP?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 55, register page 30, entry 3; waypoint 9R2F-FMH), the father's and mother's cells magnified at 1.15× and again at 1.8×; «Defranceschi» is written out in full in a cell of its own.* ***«Liciniana» is Ližnjan.*** *So this is a man of the name who came to Pomer from Ližnjan, three kilometres off Medulin, and **not** a member of Tomas's household (house 5): his father is another Antonius, he lives at house 17, and no link to Tomas or Michele is claimed.*

***That is also the 1885 groom the marriage book would not name.*** *The marriages 1885–1910, page «24», lists in its Genitores columns a groom whose father is «**Defranceschi Antonius, agricola**» and whose mother is «**Škifić Maria**, (jam defuncta)», and a bride whose parents are «**Radešić Antonius**» and «**Miletić Euphemia**», both dead.* **`doc`** *— DGS 005497827 (marriages 1885–1910), frame [25](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-V9VV?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-ZNT), right-hand page 24, row 8, read at 1800px.* ***The bride's father is Antonius Radešić, and the mother of Mathias is Euphemia, daughter of the late Antonius Radešić; the groom's father is Antonius Defranceschi, and the father of Mathias is Antonius, son of Antonius; the wedding is in 1885 and the child is born in February 1886.*** `inf` **— one couple, married in 1885, whose names page this film does not carry.** *The two entries are never tied by a name on a single page, and the baptism does not say «married in 1885».*

***⭐⭐ And the Pula marriage book closes the chain, in his own words.*** **20 October 1890, Pula, entry 136: «*Defranceschi Antonius, bajulus*» — a porter — «*die 20 aprilis 1848 natus*», born at «Lisignano» [Ližnjan], «*Viduus Euphemiae Radešić Polae 1 maji 1890 mortuae*» — *widower of Euphemia Radešić, who died at Pula on 1 May 1890* — aged 43, living at Pula since May 1890 in via Medolino 174, marrying **Lucia Climan**, a servant born 27 March 1863, daughter of the late Mathaeus Climan and Maria Trost.** **`doc`** — *Pula parish marriages 1882–1892, DGS 005497841, frame [626](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899X-RLD6?cc=2040054&wc=9R28-VZW) (image 303 of 380, waypoint 9R28-VZW), both pages read at 1800px.* ***The page names the same first wife as the Pomer baptism of Mathias (Euphemia Radešić), and its Genitores columns give his father as «Defranceschi Antonius, agricola» and his mother as «Schifich, defª Maria» — the same pair, the mother already dead, that the Pomer marriage of 1885 gave.*** *So the 1885 groom, the labourer of 1886 and the Pula porter of 1890 are one man, **Antonius Defranceschi, born at Ližnjan on 20 April 1848, son of Antonius and Maria Škifić**, and the index row «Antonius Defranceschi b. 1848» that this archive carried at Pula is him.* `doc` for the identity (a first wife named in two registers, and parents named in two registers); **only the 1885 marriage itself is still unread** (its names page is not on the film).

**What it adds, and the Pula deaths book answers the first open question.** *He left Ližnjan for Pomer, where he was a labourer at house 17 in 1886; he moved to Pula, where on **1 May 1890** his wife died — and a week before her, **a newborn son**.* **`doc`** — *Pula deaths 1864–1893, image 616 of 716 ([open](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L99X-L7D7?cc=2040054&wc=9R2C-T3D)), both pages read at 1800px and the two entries magnified at 1.15×:* **entry 233 (page 875): «*Defranceschi Euphemia, qd. Antonii Radešich e Barbana, vilica, uxor Antonii Defranceschi*» — died 1 May 1890 at 1 a.m., aged 33 as read, buried on the 3rd.** *That confirms her father (Antonius Radešić) and her parish (Barban) exactly as the Pomer baptism of 1886 gave them.* **And entry 228 (page 874): «*Defranceschi Joannes, Antonii … Pola*» — two days old, died at the Civic Hospital on 25 April 1890 of *immaturitas*, buried the 27th.** `inf` *— the son of this Antonius and of Euphemia, born about 23 April: the surname, the father's forename, Pula, the week before her death and the hospital all fit, and no other Defranceschi household is known at Pula then; but the entry names no mother, and it is not claimed as certain.* **So in May 1890 he lost a wife and a premature son within seven days, and within six months, on 20 October, he married again — Lucia Climan, a servant.** **Mathias, born 1886, is in neither entry and nothing says whether he lived.** *The Ližnjan household of «Antonio Defranceschi × Maria Schifich» (1844–1848: Cattarina, who died in 1855, and Antonius) is this man's birth family, and Ližnjan is his origin: **the second Defranceschi household of Pomer is a Ližnjan one.***

***⭐⭐ The baptism itself, at Ližnjan, in the same hand as the rest.*** **«Li 20 Aprile 1848», house 17: «*Antonio figlio di Antonio*» — father «*Antonio Defranceschi fu Matteo, agricoltore*», mother «*Maria di Lorenzo Schiffich, agricoltrice*»; godfather *Nicolò Lorencini d'Antonio of Medolino*.** **`doc`** — *Ližnjan births 1816–1864, page 56, image 27 of 92 in waypoint 9R2Z-44D ([open](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99X-GCB4?cc=2040054&wc=9R2Z-44D)), magnified at 1.15×.* **The infant's cell carries no birth date, and the Pula marriage of 1890, which calls 20 April 1848 his birth, is therefore giving the baptism day.** ***And the same page-pair holds an elder brother of the same name: «7 Giugno 1846», house 17, «Antonio, nato li 5 Giugno»,*** *to the same «Antonio Defra-nceschi fu Matteo» and «Maria Schiffich», twenty-two months earlier* (*image 25, [open](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899X-GZS7?cc=2040054&wc=9R2Z-44D)*). **And the burial book has him: «Li 19 Giugno 1846», house 17, «*Antonio Defranceschi di Antonio*», eleven days old (as read), «Naturale»** — `doc`, *Ližnjan deaths 1815–1900, page 24, image 16 of waypoint 9R2Z-4WG ([open](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899X-GCVN?cc=2040054&wc=9R2Z-4WG)).* *The first Antonio lived less than two weeks, and the name was given again to the son of 1848.*

**A house with two Defranceschi families, and now the marriages say they are one.** *The facing page of the burial book records, from house 17, «Giovanni Defranceschi di Gregorio» (11 November 1846) and «Maria figlia di Gregorio Defranceschi» (8 December 1846) — children of **Gregorio Defranceschi (b. 1822) and Agata Schiffich**.* **And the marriage book has both couples, fourteen months apart, at house 17:** **15 November 1843, entry 85 — «*Antonio Defranceschi fu Matteo*», agricoltore, 23, and «*Maria Schiffich di Lorenzo*», 26; parents «*Matteo Defranceschi e Maddalena …ovich*» and «*Lorenzo Schiffich e Maria …*»** — and **22 January 1845, entry 94 — «*Gregorio Defranceschi*», 23, and «*Agata Schiffich*», 23; the fathers written «*Matteo Defra-nceschi*» and «*Lorenzo Schiffich*»** — **`doc`**, *Ližnjan marriages 1815–1902, pages 11 and 12, images 9 and 10 of waypoint 9R2Z-44C ([open](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L99X-GC6H?cc=2040054&wc=9R2Z-44C), [open](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99X-GCWP?cc=2040054&wc=9R2Z-44C)), entry 85 magnified at 1.15×, entry 94's fathers at 1.15×.* ***Two Defranceschi men of one house, sons of a Matteo, married to two daughters of one Lorenzo Schiffich: they are Antonio's and Gregorio's two pairs of the same four parents.*** `doc` *— brothers (the baptisms of 1819 and 1822, below, name the same parents), and sisters-in-law who are sisters.* **Antonio was born about 1820** (23 in November 1843) **and Gregorio in 1822** (his baptism, 1:1:XQM3-P8CX), **to a Matteo and a Maddalena** — so Antonio's baptism should be in the Ližnjan births of 1816–1821, about two years before Gregorio's, and has not been read.*

**So the chain is complete in three registers: Ližnjan 1848 (the baptism, parents Antonio fu Matteo and Maria Schiffich) → Pomer 1886 (the labourer «filius Antonii e Liciniana») → Pula 1890 (porter, widower, born 20 April 1848, parents Antonius and the late Maria Schifich).** *His father was still alive in 1890 — «agricola», with no cross — and a «fu Matteo» in 1846–48 puts the grandfather Matteo Defranceschi among the dead of Ližnjan before 1846; he is not identified.*

***⭐⭐ Two generations further back, and a byname that has been in this archive since October.*** **16 September 1819, Ližnjan, house 17: «*Antonio*, born 15 September 1819» — father «*Mattio di Franceschi di Antonio, detto Matulin*, agricoltore», mother «*Madalena nata Percovich*»; godparents Luca Percovich fu Luca and his wife Maria.** **`doc`** — *Ližnjan births 1816–1864, page 4, image 6 of 92 in waypoint 9R2Z-44D ([open](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99X-GC21?cc=2040054&wc=9R2Z-44D)), read at full resolution.* **So the Antonio of the 1843 marriage was born in 1819 (the marriage says «23»; the baptism puts him a year older), and his father is Mattio — and Mattio is himself «di Antonio».** *Mattio's wife is Madalena Percovich; the same couple, at the same house, have **Maria, born 6 January 1821** (page 5, image 6), and **Gregorio, baptised 23 May 1822** — *read on the page (image 7, page 6): «Gregorio, figlio di Mattio di Franceschi, detto Matulin, di Antonio», mother «Madalena nata Percovich», house 17, godparents Lorenzo Vognich and Maria ([open](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899X-GZ8Z?cc=2040054&wc=9R2Z-44D)); the index's «Madalena Peuc…» was this Percovich.* ***That settles the family: Antonio (1819), Maria (1821) and Gregorio (1822) are three children of Mattio Defranceschi di Antonio, detto Matulin, and Madalena Percovich, at house 17 — and Antonio and Gregorio are brothers.*** **`doc`** *— three baptisms read, one couple.* ***And «detto Matulin»: the old Pomer deaths index carries a line «Antonio Defranceschi d.º Mattulia — 22» which this archive has called the earliest Defranceschi at Pomer and could not place.*** `inf` — *«Matulin» is the family's byname at Ližnjan, so that Antonio, dead before 1866, is probably of this family: perhaps Mattio's father Antonio (Mattio is «di Antonio»), who is the generation that reaches back toward 1780. Not established; the Pomer index line gives no date, and the Ližnjan book gives Mattio's father no dates either.*

**The chain, in full: Antonio «Matulin» (Defranceschi) → Mattio, who married Madalena Percovich → Antonio (b. 1819) and his brother Gregorio (b. 1822) → Antonius (b. 1848) → Mathias (b. 1886) — five generations in one house at Ližnjan and its descendants at Pomer and Pula.** *Only the last three links are read in the registers; the first is inference from a byname.*

⚠ *Still open: the 1885 marriage's own entry (Pomer), the cause of Euphemia's death, who the first Antonio «detto Matulin» was and where he lies, and what became of Mathias and of any children of Lucia Climan.*

rows.lab: 1858 · Tomas dies
rows.text: **5 April 1858, house 33: «*Tomaso Defranceschi*», male, aged 59, *Tifo* — typhus.** **`doc`** — *DGS 005497827, frame [8](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L99F-V9V6?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-ZNT) (waypoint 9R2F-6YM, the old deaths book, item 3).* *The entry names no parents and no wife, so he is placed by name, village and age: **59 in 1858 is born about 1799, and the 1843 marriage said 43 — two entries, fifteen years apart, in two books and two hands, that agree.*** *Maria was five; her mother Maddalena was a widow from that day.*

rows.lab: 1859 · Magdalena, a widow, baptises a son — who is Stephanus Buić, and in 1908 a clerk writes him «Defranceschi»
rows.text:
**Born 29 July 1859, baptised 1 August, house 33: «*Stephanus*»** — the parish priest *Bartholomaeus Piz*; *Catholic, male* — and the father's cell reads «***Patre incognito***» (*father unknown*) and the mother's «***Magdalena vidua Tomasi Defranceschi nata Buich, agric.***» — *Magdalena, **widow of Tomas Defranceschi**, born Buich.* Godfather *Blasius Mihovilovich, agricola.* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [640](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L99F-KX2H?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 19, left page 29; waypoint 9R2F-FMH; burned-in number 639), the mother's cell magnified at 1.8×; every word of the mother's line is legible, including «Defranceschi» across the line-break.* ***It is the same house — 33 — where Tomas died of typhus sixteen months before***, *so she was still in her husband's house.* **⭐ It also tells us something the deaths book could not: Magdalena Buić was alive on 1 August 1859, sixteen months a widow, and had a baby that year; and on 30 July 1874 the Medulin marriage names her again.** *The father is **not** named and nothing here supplies him; the child is not given the Defranceschi surname, and this archive does not give it to him.* ⚠ **Whether Stephanus lived is not known** — *a search of the deaths book for him (a child of 1859, Pomer, house 33) is a thing to do, and he may or may not be in it.*

***⭐⭐ Stephanus is found again, as a man, in 1889 and 1890 — and he carries his mother's maiden name.*** **12 March 1890, Pomer: «*Maria*», born the 11th, house «48 / 33», to «*Stephanus Buić, filius Magdalenae De-franceschi*» and «*Emilia nata Košara*»** *(the mother's name is written in the father's cell, in a smaller hand, beneath his own: «Magdalenae De-franc-/esci»); godmother* Euphemia née Zuccon; *midwife Justina Vojak.* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [682](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L99F-KXDH?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 62, register page 37; waypoint 9R2F-FMH), magnified at 1.15×; «Defranceschi» is broken across the line and every syllable reads.* **And a year earlier, 17 March 1889, house 33: «*Josephus Emilian*», born the 13th, to «*Stefan Buić, agricola*» and «*Emilia nata Košara*»; a cross and «obiit … april 1889» stand in the margin — he lived about five weeks.** **`doc`** — *frame 681 (births frame 61, page 34), magnified at 1.15×.* ***So the child of 1859 — «Stephanus», house 33, mother «Magdalena vidua Tomasi Defranceschi nata Buich», father «incognito» — is a married labourer at house 33 in 1889, with a wife from the Košara family and two children, and he is written as «Buić», his mother's own surname, not Defranceschi.*** *The identification is* `inf`: *same forename, same house, and the filiation to «Magdalena De-franceschi» is written out in the 1890 entry itself; no other Magdalena Defranceschi is known at Pomer.* **A father's name was never entered, so the child took the mother's maiden name and the household stayed in the Defranceschi–Buić house.** ***And it means Magdalena was alive and in the family house at least until 1882 as midwife, and that her son raised children in house 33 — the house her husband died in in 1858 — thirty years on.*** ⚠ *The 1890 entry does not say whether Magdalena was still living: «filius Magdalenae» carries no «qm» and no «vidua», which is not a statement that she was alive.*

***And in June 1891 he names a daughter for her.*** *21 June 1891, Pomer, house 48:* «***Magdalena Joanna***», *born the 18th, to* «***Stephanus Buić, operarius***» *(a labourer; a short line is written under his name and cannot be read through a later stamp) and* «***Emilia n. Košara***»; *godparents Antonius and Cath. Radolović; midwife Justina Vojak.* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [685](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99F-KXJM?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 65, page 40, entry 10), magnified at 1.15×.* ***A first granddaughter born after Magdalena's own years of delivering the village's children is given her name — Magdalena — and the household has moved from house 33 to house 48.*** `inf` *for the naming: nothing says it was for her.*

***Two more entries, 1894 and 1895, partly obscured.*** *Register page 47 (DGS 005497826, frame [688](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-K6BZ?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) = births frame 68):* **entry 10, autumn 1894 — «*Buić Stephanus, f. Magdalenae*» and «*Casara* [Košara] *Emilia*»; godparents Catharina Radolović «et ejus frater Antonius»; midwife Justina Vojak. `doc`** *(magnified at 1.15×). **The child is «*Magdalena Joanna (II)*», born 12 June 1894, baptised 17 June; the mother's line adds «*Silvestri*» (her father) and a marginal note, «Umrla u Puli … 1973», records her death at Pula in 1973 (the day is not read with confidence).** *Read at 1.15× on the right-hand copy of the page (frame 689). The «(II)» is the clerk's own: **the first Magdalena Joanna of 1891 must therefore have died, and the name was given again.*** **And, at the foot of the same page, 17 February 1895, house 48/33: «*Valentinus Antonius*», born the 10th, to «*Stephanus Buić, operarius*» and «*Emilia n. Košara*»; godparents Antonius and Euphemia Rakić.** **`doc`** *— read at 1800px, not separately magnified.* ***Stephanus Buić and Emilia now have **five children on record: Josephus Emilian (1889, d. 1889), Maria (1890), Magdalena Joanna (1891, died young by inference), Magdalena Joanna II (1894, d. Pula 1973) and Valentinus Antonius (1895).*****

***⭐ And in 1897 the clerk writes the answer out.*** **6 February 1897, Pomer: «*Blasius Stephanus*», born the 4th, to «*Buich Stephanus* ***illeg.mus***» and «*Košara Milica (Emilia)*»; godparents Petrus Micovillovich and Lucia Radolovich; midwife Lucia Rakich; a cross and «*die 5. februarii 1897*» — the child died the next day.** **`doc`** — *DGS 005497826, frame [696](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99F-KXDB?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-FMH) (births frame 75, register page 52, entry 2), magnified at 1.15×; the father's line reads «Buich / Stephanus / **illegitimus**».* ***«Illegitimus» after the father's name is the register's own statement that Stephanus Buić was born out of wedlock — the same fact the 1859 entry recorded as «patre incognito».*** *That closes the identification as far as a register can: the Stephanus of 1859 (father unknown, mother Magdalena Defranceschi née Buich, house 33) and the Stephanus of 1889–97 (filius Magdalenae De-franceschi, «illegitimus», house 33 / 48) are one man.* `inf` *downgraded to **a strong inference with a register behind it**; the one thing it cannot show is that no second illegitimate Stephanus was born to a Buich woman at Pomer, which nothing suggests.* **Their sixth child on record is therefore Blasius Stephanus (4–5 Feb 1897), who lived a day.** ***From 1897 the clerks write «Pomer, Nr. __» for the house, and the book changes parish priest (Joannes Matlich, then Joannes Jerco) — and the same hand records a Lazar: «Maria Lazar, Matthaei agricolae» as the mother, with «Joannes Trost», of Natalis (b. 13 Dec 1897, house 115).*** ⚠ *That is a second child of the Maria Lazar «filia Mathei et Luciae» of 1889 (above); it is not merged with Maria Lazaro b. 1868, and «Matthaei agricolae» is the only parent named.*

***The burial register confirms the 1889 baby.*** **20 April 1889, house 33: «*Joseph Emilian Buić, filius Stefani et Emiliae natae Škodara agricolae*», 41 days, debilitas** — *the child born 13 March, baptised 17 March, with «obiit … april 1889» in the margin; the book gives the name of the father and of the mother's family, both as in the baptism.* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497827, frame [80](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-V94H?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-6YM) (deaths frame 36, left page 20, entry 5 of 1889).* *«Emilia née Škodara» here and «Košara» in the baptism are one name read two ways; the house, the forenames and the age settle it.*

***Two more of Stephanus's children are in the burial book.*** **11 March 1890, house 33: «*Maria Buić filia Stephani et Emiliae natae Škodara, operarii*», aged 1 day, debilitas** *(frame 80, deaths frame 37, left page 22, entry 5 — the baptism says born the 11th and baptised the 12th, so the day of death as read, the 11th, is one day short of the baptism; both are kept as read).* **And 20 April 1896, house 48/33, buried the 21st: «*Valentinus Antonius*», about a year and two months, febris** *(frame 83, deaths frame 40, left page 28, entry 4 of 1896; the father written «Stephanus et Emilia Buić, operarii», the number of the child's age months partly struck).* **`doc`.** ***So of Stephanus and Emilia's six children, three are known dead as babies (Josephus Emilian, Maria, Valentinus Antonius) and a fourth, the first Magdalena Joanna, by the clerk's «(II)»; the 1894 Magdalena Joanna (II) survived to 1973 and Blasius Stephanus (1897) lived a day.*** *The deaths book for 1890–1895 was read page by page for «Buić Magdalena», «Defranceschi» and «Lazar»: Magdalena does not die in it.*

***Blasius Stephanus's burial.*** **5 February 1897, buried the 7th: «*Buich Blasius Stephanus, Stephani et Milizae Rossandae filius legitimus*», 1 day, debilitas** — *the register's own word «legitimus» for the child, while the baptism two pages earlier wrote the father «illeg.mus»; both words are in the books.* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497827, frame [84](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-899F-V9XJ?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-6YM) (deaths frame 41, left page 30, entry 3 of 1897).*

***A seventh child, in the burial book only — and an eighth, Martinus, six years later.*** **6 March 1902, house 33 (new numbering 52): «*Catharina Buić, Stephani et Milicae, agricola*», born 19 February 1902, aged half a month, congenita debilitas; buried the 8th** *(frame 90, deaths frame 46, right page 41, entry 4 of 1902).* **`doc`** — *the births book had already ended in August 1900, so she is in no baptism read here.* ***From 1901 the clerk adds the birth date and the date of marriage under each adult's name; the Pomer deaths book 1880–1903 was read through for every Buić woman, Defranceschi and Lazar adult, and neither Magdalena (widow of Tomas) nor Lucia (widow of Matheus) is buried in it.*** *Both are therefore either alive after September 1903 — Lucia, at least, until the 1905 wedding — or buried elsewhere; Lucia's death must lie after 2 July 1905 and is not in the 1867–1910 pages read so far.*

***⭐⭐ 1908: the clerk writes the surname the register had never let him have.*** **10 February 1908, house 62 (new numbering): «*Martinus (Defranceschi*, **Buich** *written above, as a correction)* *Stephani et Aemiliae Kosara*», 10 days old, debilitas — «*mater aegrotabat*» (the mother was ill); buried the 12th.** *The child was born 1 February 1908.* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497827, frame [96](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99F-V98R?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-6YM) (deaths frame 53, right page 55, entry 4 of 1908), magnified at 1.15×: «Defranceschi» is written in full inside the brackets, a pencil-grey smudge under it, and «Buich» is added above the bracket in a smaller hand.* ***It is the only time in the Pomer books that Stephanus's son is written with the surname Defranceschi — and the clerk, who knew the family by its house, wrote his grandmother's husband's name first, then replaced it with the one the family had actually used for fifty years.*** *It is the register itself saying what the 1859 entry left unsaid: that this household was understood in the village as the Defranceschi household, and that Buić was what the clerks had to write because the child had no father's name to take.* **Stephanus's eighth child is Martinus (1908).** *Born 1 February 1908 — after the births book ends, so he is in no baptism read here.*

rows.lab: 1861 · Michele dies at fourteen
rows.text: **12 December 1861, house 33: «*Michael Defranceschi filius Defuncti Thomae*», male, aged 14, «*ex febre maligna*».** **`doc`** — *frame 9.* ***«Defuncti Thomae» — son of the late Thomas — is the proof of who he is,*** *and he died in the house his father had died in. **This confirms the FamilySearch index record 6YB5-VPNF**, held until now as an unread lead («Michael Defrančichi», b. 1847, d. 12 Dec 1861, father Thomae): **the index was right, and the surname it said was «not indexed» is Defranceschi.***

rows.lab: ⚠ The correction: Buić, not Davić
rows.text: **This archive carried the mother as «Magdalena Davić» from 13 September 2026 until the Pomer books were read.** *The first reading was the Medulin 1874 marriage, and it was wrong: that cell is four glyphs before the accent, a two-lobed* **B** *where the same scribe's* **D** *in «De-franceschi», one cell to its left on the same row, is a different form — and «Davić» needs five.* **Four Pomer entries then give it unaided: «Buich» in 1843, 1844, 1847 and 1852, «Buić» in 1866.** ***The person is unchanged, and so is her id — it still says «davic», because an id is minted once and frozen.*** *Corrected in the roster, this page and the log; recorded on /corrections/.*

rows.lab: Where do they say anyone came from?
rows.text: **Asked on 14 October 2026; the answer so far, entry by entry.** **Tomas Defranceschi — «*Nubile da Pomer*», 16 August 1843** — *the marriage book's own wording for him, son of «Michele»;* **`doc`** — *DGS 005497827, frame [10](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L99F-V9F5?cc=2040054&wc=9R2F-ZNT), magnified. The same page writes «della Villa di Promontore», «della Villa di Medolino» and «della Parrocchia di Stignano» for grooms from elsewhere, so «da Pomer» is a statement and not a default: **he is a man of Pomer, and no earlier place is named.*** **Magdalena Buich** *is given only a house, 28, in the same entry; her baptism at Pomer in 1816 is the better evidence she was born there.* **Maria, their daughter,** *is «oriunda e Pomer» at Medulin in 1874.* **Matheus Lazaro** *(1866 marriage, frame 15) — no origin is written beside him, and his house cell is blank.* **The one place of origin the Pomer books name for anyone of the surname is Antonius's: «e Liciniana» — Ližnjan — in 1886, and the Pula marriage of 1890 repeats it with his birth date, 20 April 1848** *(above).* **Gregorio (1827), Michele, the index line «Antonio Defranceschi d.º Mattulia»:** *no origin. «Mattulia» is a byname or a place and is not read as either.* ***(The Ližnjan books carry the family a generation higher: Mattio is «di Antonio, detto Matulin» in 1819 — see 1885–90 above.)* *So: nothing in these records says where the Defranceschi of Pomer came from before Pomer. Tomas is Pomer by 1843, his father Michele is a name, and the nearest place the books offer is Ližnjan, for a different Antonius forty years later.***

rows.lab: What this does NOT establish
rows.text: **Tomas's own baptism, about 1799–1800, is in no book this archive can open:** the Pomer births volume begins in 1816. **Michele, his father, is named and not otherwise known.** **No death entry has been found for Magdalena or for Lucia.** *Lucia was alive in 1899; Magdalena's would be filed under Buić, and the 1867–1910 book was read for Defranceschi, not for Buić — so hers may be in it.* **«Pietro Defranceschi, b. 1793, Pomer»** *is **not** joined to this family by anything.* **The earliest Defranceschi at Pomer by a document is now Gregorio, named in a 1827 margin as a godmother's father; the earliest by an index line remains:** *«Antonio Defranceschi d.º Mattulia — 22» at the front of the old deaths book, with no entry behind it on the eleven surviving pages — a number that belongs to an earlier book not on this film.* **And one groom is not named by his own entry:** *a son of «Defranceschi Antonius» marries at Pomer in 1885, on a page whose names half the film does not carry* — **but the births book names him as the father of Mathias, 1886 (above), and the inference is set out there.**
